value.rationale: This is a natural exact object-identification problem: it connects a newly described completely regular extended cyclic code to a historically studied affine incidence code with a rich dual, design-theoretic classification and full known automorphism group. Equality is substantially stronger than a shared parameter set or weight enumerator and allows transfer of established geometric results. The old group and rank are credited as prior art; the identification itself is the motivated contribution, not a cosmetic renaming.
